summary: Current implementation satisfies the saved DB-backed profile hook plan. Workspace profiles model database.generated_setup and database.pre_validation_refresh hooks with ProfileCommand coercion; runtime inserts db_generated_setup after setup and db_refresh before healthchecks/validate with durable artifacts, log streams, metadata, and hook-specific failure/timeout reason codes; executor provenance, command counts, validation reason mapping, and environment identity include DB refresh/setup hooks; the Python/Postgres fixture declares workspace-local hooks using DATABASE_URL and does not expose AWF control-plane Postgres. Focused tests, ruff, mypy, full unit tests, and the 99% coverage gate pass.
